name: BackToTop
label: Back to top
description: A round button in the page's corner that appears on a long scroll and takes the reader back to the top.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far, in px, the page scrolls before the button appears. `0` shows it at once.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button.

props.name: focusTarget
props.description:
The id of the element to move focus to after the jump (the page's main
region, say), so a keyboard reader continues from the top too. Leave it
out to keep focus on the button.

keys.note: A native button: the browser owns Enter and Space, and the press scrolls the page.
